update.name: useEnergy — Prime/Frenzy Energy Meter Hook
update.context: The energy system replaces the old AP/Frenzy system entirely. Single meter per player, range 0-300. 0-150 = PRIME (turn-based). 151-300 = FRENZY (simultaneous shared board). Global mode: any player crossing 151 switches ALL players to FRENZY. Local energy: per-player independent value. Anchor: player who first triggered FRENZY (tracked). Energy tick uses requestAnimationFrame — NEVER setInterval.

dependencies.dep: apps/client/src/hooks/useGame.ts — will consume globalMode from this hook

constraints.constraint: RAF loop ONLY. Never use setInterval for energy tick.
Cleanup cancelAnimationFrame on unmount — no memory leaks.
globalMode is passed as prop, not owned internally by this hook.
forceToFrenzy sets energy to FRENZY_THRESHOLD + 1 exactly.
onEnergyZero fires exactly once per depletion event — use ref flag.
No Math.random(). No game state mutations. Hook is purely energy.

do-not.rule: Do not use setInterval for energy tick — RAF only.
Do not own globalMode inside this hook — it is passed as a prop.
Do not import from framer-motion — use motion/react if animation needed.
Do not add React.StrictMode — it is disabled project-wide.
Do not reference AP system, speedMeter, or old isFrenzy — those are deleted.

verification.check: applyChainEnergy with len=6 adds +10 in PRIME mode
applyChainEnergy with len=6 and usedWild=true adds +20 in PRIME mode
energy never exceeds MAX_ENERGY or goes below 0
